prompt: Produce a report synthesizing this corpus into one account. First, define the wit precisely as the unit of witnessed change (one witnessed distinction-step) and the tally as its border-settled form, drawing only on the glossary terms and the witness-bit assay contract and schema. Second, lay out the critical upstream mathematics that makes a distinction-step a countable, priced quantity: the index-balance theorem H0 - H1 = chi, Landauer vs anti-Landauer entropy (one erased bit per independent cycle), the settling-cohomology H1 machinery, and the articulation primitives (Utterance, Cell, FourCorner, Trace) that carry the economic-bit payload. Third, explain the connection developed in the Obsmetrologia program between the gyrobifastigial Chu space (the crystallographic, tileable territory), the conjectured information forms, and the whirling dervishes (the D5, non-crystallographic obstruction the territory cannot tile and the market cannot relax), including the machine-checked disclination/KCBS-pentagon bridge. Finally, tie the two together: how the wit currency is the conserved quantity of the same Laplacian settling flow whose one un-dischargeable defect is the dervish, floor-priced at the golden gap 2 - phi. Keep every technical name (theorems, Lean modules, blueprint nodes) exactly as written in the sources, and clearly separate established/machine-checked claims from open conjectures.
